_comment: wq#3808 LIMPET meta-server registry manifest. Edit this file and the running meta-server picks up the change within reload_poll_sec (or immediately on SIGHUP, which cuts the wait short) with no restart. Changing an mcp_servers entry's command or env restarts that child; startup_timeout_sec/request_timeout_sec bound every read from it, so a child that stops answering costs only its own tools (wq#3821).
